section.title: Evidence and status

strow.stentry: Draft, not reviewed, and unconfirmed: the group did not re-form reliably (stability 0.33). It is named only because a need points at it.
Mixed: the group holds more than one kind of service. Split into visits received at home (home help, personal assistant, nurse visits) and visiting people in hospitals and care homes.
Did not recur reliably when the data was resampled; it is named only because a need points at it, so treat the name as a proposal and the group as unconfirmed.

section.p: Identifier in this run: svc-161. Identifiers are cluster numbers of one run and change whenever the clustering is re-run; they are not stable ids.
